plainLanguage: Sections 50 hadi 54 zimefutwa (repealed). R.E. 2022 haiziwasilishi kama offences zinazotumika.
meaning: The current Code preserves these numbers only as a repeal marker. Historical provisions must not be reconstructed as current law.
keyPoints: R.E. 2022 attributes the repeal to Act No. 3 of 1976 s. 55.
No current substantive offence text should be invented.

legalTerms.meaning: Provision imeondolewa na legislation iliyofuata na si operative text ya current Code.

history.summary: R.E. 2022 records sections 50-54 as repealed by Act No. 3 of 1976 s. 55.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: Digital library should preserve the exact current legislative status and avoid reconstructing unsupported law.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: Application must follow the complete statutory wording and the law in force at the relevant time.

debateQuestion: Ni statutory text na legal status ipi inayotumika kwa facts na tarehe husika?
disclaimer: Ufafanuzi huu si maandishi rasmi ya sheria.
